title: Filings
description: An album cover drawn in nine thousand iron filings, each lying along the picture's own contours. A second magnet pops in nose to nose and flips, and a ripple rolls out across the field as it swings into a bridge of lines — drag, twist or shake them yourself.
intent: One physical mechanic finished to the edge: a real cover becomes iron filings that comb into field lines around two draggable magnets, opening on the repulsion-to-bridge flip.
